lines.japanese: 僕は自分のケータイのメモ帳に記してある、残務処理のことを思い出した。
lines.english: I remembered the Unfinished Business recorded in the notepad on my phone.

lines.japanese: 「あの、一つだけ気にかかることがあるんです」
lines.english: “Um, there's just one thing still weighing on me.”

lines.japanese: 「ん？　なんだァ？」
lines.english: “Hmm? What's that?”

lines.japanese: 「卒業文集の製作がまだ終わってなくて……」
lines.english: “We still haven't finished the graduation anthology...”

lines.japanese: 今日の午後に僕は気を失ってしまったから、まだ完成を見てないんだ。
lines.english: I had lost consciousness that afternoon, so I hadn’t seen the finished anthology.

lines.japanese: 「ああ、あれなァ……さっき職員室に持って行って、了解をもらってきた」
lines.english: “Ah, that. I took it to the staff room a little while ago and got their approval.”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「あとはおまえの寄せ書きだけだ。よかったな、班長」
lines.english: “All that's left is your class message. Good for you, group leader.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、はは……そう、ですね。よかったです」
lines.english: “Ah... ha ha. Yes. That's... good.”

lines.japanese: 「そっか、完成したんだあ。おれの居ない間にありがとうございました」
lines.english: “I see. So it's finished. Thank you for taking care of it while I was gone.”

lines.japanese: 「別に」
lines.english: “It was nothing.”

lines.japanese: 僕は頭を下げて、くるりと針生さんに背を向ける。
lines.english: I bowed my head, then turned away from Hariu.

lines.japanese: 羽田班には優秀なひとが集まってくれて本当によかった。僕なんか居なくても、最初からみんなに任せておけばよかったんだ。
lines.english: I was really glad the Haneda Squad had so many capable people in it. They would've been fine without me. I should've just left everything to them from the start.

lines.japanese: そう、それだ。絶対それだよ。
lines.english: Yes. That was it. That had to be it.

lines.japanese: きっと先生やクラスメイトのみんなも喜んでくれると思う。本当に素晴らしいことだ。
lines.english: Surely our teacher and all our classmates would be pleased too. It was truly wonderful.

lines.japanese: こっそりとケータイを取り出して、残務処理の欄を更新した。
lines.english: I slipped out my phone and quietly updated the Unfinished Business note.

lines.japanese: “済：卒業文集を完成させる”
lines.english: [DONE: Complete the graduation anthology]

lines.japanese: 夕食の時間もとっくに過ぎて、普段ならお風呂にも入り終わってる時間。
lines.english: Dinner was long over. Normally, I'd have finished my bath by now.

lines.japanese: 僕はまだ外で、ベンチに腰掛けながら冬の風に当たっていた。
lines.english: But I was still outside, sitting on a bench in the winter wind.

lines.japanese: 残務処理も全てこなした。身近なひととは全て話した。
lines.english: Every last bit of unfinished business was done. I'd talked to everyone close to me.

lines.japanese: 本来なら学校を卒業するまでが僕の役割なんだろうけど、明日、学校に行くのも億劫だ。
lines.english: Normally, I guess my role would last until graduation, but even going to school tomorrow felt like too much trouble.

lines.japanese: 学校に行っても、卒業文集の製作をするという役割の済んだ僕は、いつも通りに窓の外を眺めるだけで一日が終わるだろう。
lines.english: Even if I went to school, my job on the graduation anthology was done. I'd probably spend the whole day staring out the window like always.

lines.japanese: ただ一人この僕の物語に彩を添えてくれた渡来さんにも、きっと愛想を尽かされているだろう。
lines.english: Even Watarai, the one person who had given color to my story, had surely washed her hands of me.

lines.japanese: こんなときグレタガルドに行けば次の日はなにも気にせずに居られたんだけど、今ではその世界に行くことすら出来ない。
lines.english: Before, if I went to Gretagard at a time like this, I could get through the next day without worrying about anything. But now I couldn't even go there.

lines.japanese: じゃあどうしようか。
lines.english: Then what should I do?

lines.japanese: もういいんじゃないかな。
lines.english: Maybe that's enough.

lines.japanese: 驚くくらい次になにをしようという行動が思いつかない。なんの期待も浮かばない。
lines.english: It was kind of amazing. I couldn't think of a single thing to do next. Nothing to look forward to, either.

lines.japanese: 言ってみればゲームオーバー。もう未練だってないはずだ。
lines.english: You could call it game over. I shouldn't even have any attachments left by now.

lines.japanese: あはは、考えてみても本当に僕にはないや。あとはいつかどこかでふらりと消えるだけだ。
lines.english: Ahaha. Even if I think about it, I really don't have any. All that's left is to wander off and disappear somewhere, someday.

lines.japanese: それはいつだろう、どこだろう。なんなら今すぐでも構わない。
lines.english: When would that be? Where? It could be right now, for all I cared.

lines.japanese: 目を瞑ると意識が遠のいていくようだった。
lines.english: When I closed my eyes, my consciousness seemed to recede into the distance.

lines.japanese: 鳶の声も聞こえない、鐘の音も聞こえない、足元に落ちることすらない消滅の世界。
lines.english: No cry of the kite. No sound of bells. A world of erasure where I would not even fall to the ground beneath my feet.

lines.japanese: 全ての記憶が奪われ、僕の意思の全てが飲みこまれていく。
lines.english: Every memory taken from me. Every last piece of my will swallowed whole.

lines.japanese: さようなら、僕の空っぽだった物語。
lines.english: Farewell, my empty story.

lines.japanese: 世界が平和でありますように。
lines.english: *May peace prevail on Earth.*

lines.japanese: 「あ、あのぅ、こんばんはっ」
lines.english: “U-um, good evening!”

lines.japanese: 「え、ああこんばんは……」
lines.english: “Oh. Good evening...”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、えっと、こんなところでなにをされてたんですか？」
lines.english: Oh, um... may I ask what you were doing out here?

lines.japanese: 「えっ？　ちょっと考えごと……」
lines.english: “What? I was just... thinking.”

lines.japanese: 「そ、そうなんですか。あ、あのっ、ちょっとお時間よろしいでしょうか。私、同じ学校の……」
lines.english: “I-I see. Um! Could I have a moment of your time? I go to the same school, and...”

lines.japanese: それはそれとして、もしこのあとも僕の物語が続いていたら、そのときは女の子に自分から声でもかけてみようかな、なんて思った。
lines.english: Anyway, if my story kept going after this, maybe next time I'd try being the one to talk to a girl first.
